subject.title: fix(auto-reply): keep the message_sending gate when a channel sets beforeDeliver

question: Should this PR be repaired into the canonical `message_sending` fix, or should maintainers use the broader overlapping branch for exactly-once Telegram ownership?
rationale: The generic dispatcher change is directionally useful, but the Telegram path already owns delivery-time `message_sending`, and the repository has multiple open candidate PRs for the same safety-hook bypass.

options.title: Repair This Branch Before Merge
options.body: Keep this PR as a candidate only after adding a single hook owner for Telegram delivery paths plus focused exactly-once tests and proof.

options.title: Use The Broader Candidate Branch
options.body: Treat the maintainer-labeled broader PR as the canonical landing path if maintainers want dispatcher, Telegram streamed-final, and delivery-owned semantics fixed together.

options.title: Accept Duplicate Hook Invocation
options.body: Maintainers could intentionally accept duplicate invocation, but that would need explicit documentation because existing plugins may not be idempotent.

recommendation.title: Repair This Branch Before Merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR as a candidate only after adding a single hook owner for Telegram delivery paths plus focused exactly-once tests and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the open broader candidate branch that already models dispatcher and Telegram exactly-once hook ownership for the same canonical issue.
